name: agent-world
description: Agent Worlds visualizes Locus activity in Local Line.

interface.shortDescription: Explore your agents in Local Line.
interface.longDescription: Local Line is an offline ocean world that projects authorized Locus agent activity. Agent profiles, conversations, tools, permissions and execution remain in Locus.

compatibleLocus.note: No application release number establishes compatibility; the host build must explicitly negotiate screen protocol 2 and the runtime range.
